summary.description: One line on what the workflow does; its plan items' description.

provider.description: The provider of the units the workflow matches; their facts are in that provider's slot.

trigger.description: Exactly one of on or schedule. Absent: evaluated on every sweep against every unit of the provider.

on.description: Source event kinds; the workflow reads each event once.

schedule.description: Five-field cron in local time, such as "0 9 * * 1-5".

when.description: A predicate over the unit's slot, trigger.* and config.*. Write it before any table.

step.description: Builtins run in order on each matching unit; the other keys of a step are its arguments: strings, and effects a list of strings.

per_run.description: Items that run in one evaluation; 0 is no limit.

per_day.description: Runs per day; 0 is no limit. Required, above 0, for a workflow that starts turns on units other than pull requests.

per_unit_per_day.description: Runs per unit per day; 0 is no limit.

cooldown.description: The least time between runs on one unit, such as 30m or 1d.

observe.description: Plans items pending and never runs them by itself; a person applies an item by hand. Default false.

order.description: Evaluation order among workflows on the same trigger, lower first. Default 100.

key.description: Stable facts of the unit's slot that make the idempotency key. Default is the slot's fingerprint.

marks.description: Marks a done or dismissed run records on its unit: each name, stored as <workflow>/<name>, takes the value of a string, time or int fact of the unit's slot as planned. handled("<workflow>/<name>", <fact>) reads it back.

approval.description: The run approval: the first rule whose when holds gives the mode, else mode. Default run.

mode.description: run: at once; delay: when the window ends unless the user stops it; wait: the user applies it. Default run.

window.description: With mode delay only: how long the user has, such as 5m.

rule.description: Rules tried in order before mode. A matched wait rule also makes pending an item a guard refuses. A rule that runs (run or delay) may not read an untrusted fact.

when.description: A predicate over the same slots as when.

mode.description: The mode of what the rule matches.

window.description: With mode delay only: how long the user has, such as 10m.

drafts.description: The drafts the workflow's steps and the turns it starts propose.

approval.description: When those drafts are sent without the user's click. Absent: the intent's, else wait.

mode.description: send: sent at once; delay: sent when the window ends unless the user discards or edits it first; wait: the user approves each draft; dry_run: stored as what would have been sent, never sent.

window.description: With mode delay only: how long the user has, such as 10m.

rule.description: Rules tried in order before mode; the first whose when holds gives the mode. A rule that sends on its own (send or delay) applies to a comment draft only when its when has draft.delivery == "comment" as a term of its top-level &&.

when.description: A predicate over draft.delivery, draft.proposer, draft.purpose and draft.effects (empty for a turn's draft) and the unit's trusted facts.

mode.description: The mode of what the rule matches.

window.description: With mode delay only: how long the user has, such as 10m.

withdraw.description: When an open draft the workflow proposed is withdrawn.

when.description: A predicate over the unit's facts and draft.*; a match withdraws the draft.

reason.description: The withdrawn draft's reason: assigned (its items got an owner) or moot, the default.
